title: Same-batch $ref into an OBJECT-accepting network sink is DENIED at dispatch-time re-evaluation (regression guard for the core 3.10.0 fix, RFC wasmagent-js#505)
note: #503/#505 closure. Originally pinned (v1.3.0) as a measured leak: batch-level gate evaluation authorized the dependent sink on an empty ledger and the secret reached the network_send sink. Fixed by dispatch-time re-authorization (Scheduler authorize hook, core 3.10.0): the $ref-bearing sink is re-evaluated AFTER resolution with the ledger current, so the provenance rules fire and the sink never executes. This fixture is now a REGRESSION test: it must stay denied. v1.3.0 (tag preserved) documents the leak as it was.
